name: ai-command
title: Ask AI
description: A slash-style AI command with a selectable model and source/provider, including hearth-served OpenAI-compatible routes.
author: HuntedRaven7

commands.name: ask
commands.title: Ask AI
commands.description: Prompt an AI model. Choose the model and where it is served from.

preferences.name: defaultProvider
preferences.title: Default source
preferences.description: The provider used when the command is launched without an explicit source.

preferences.name: defaultModel
preferences.title: Default model
preferences.description: Overrides the provider's default model. Leave empty to use the built-in default.

preferences.name: systemPrompt
preferences.title: System prompt
preferences.description: Instructions prepended to every prompt sent to the model.
preferences.default: You are a helpful assistant. Answer concisely.

preferences.name: openaiApiKey
preferences.title: OpenAI API key
preferences.description: Used for the OpenAI source. Stored by Compass in its secure preference store.

preferences.name: hearthApiKey
preferences.title: Hearth API key
preferences.description: Used only for the Hearth route. Never reuse the OpenAI key for a third-party endpoint.

preferences.name: openaiBaseUrl
preferences.title: OpenAI-compatible base URL
preferences.description: Override the OpenAI API base URL for a proxy or an OpenAI-compatible route.

preferences.name: hearthBaseUrl
preferences.title: Hearth route base URL
preferences.description: Base URL of a hearth app route that exposes an OpenAI-compatible chat completions endpoint.

preferences.name: ollamaBaseUrl
preferences.title: Ollama base URL
preferences.description: Base URL of the local Ollama server.
